summary: In this amendment VF reports the threat actor was ejected on December 15, 2023, systems are substantially restored with operations back to normal apart from minor residual issues, roughly 35.5 million consumers' personal data was stolen (no SSNs, bank or card data, no evidence of passwords), the incident is not material to financial condition or results, and VF will claim on its cyber insurance.
new_vs_prior: New relative to the December 18, 2023 8-K: containment date (threat actor ejected December 15, 2023); operations and IT systems substantially restored with order backlog cleared; quantified data theft of approximately 35.5 million consumers' personal data with scope limits (no SSNs, bank or payment card data, no evidence of passwords); detail on the disruption (inventory replenishment, order fulfillment, order cancellations, reduced e-commerce demand, wholesale shipment delays); regulators notified; conclusion that the incident is not material to financial condition or results (previously undetermined); and intent to claim on cybersecurity insurance. Encryption is not restated.
